assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness that have persisted despite initial rate control therapy.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.9.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
The CPT code for the service is 93247.
The service is medically necessary and consistent with the documented clinical indication for the service.
